C01.target_audience: Students hearing about the event through peer representatives
C01.objective: Turn peer conversations into identified interest and completed registrations

C02.target_audience: Students discovering the event through paid social content
C02.objective: Acquire new interest and test progression from clicks to registration

C03.target_audience: Students engaging with creator-led event content
C03.objective: Move creator-content engagement toward programme exploration and registration

C04.target_audience: College clubs and groups exploring participation together
C04.objective: Help group organizers progress from programme questions to confirmed attendance

C05.target_audience: Friends invited by already interested students
C05.objective: Convert invited friends while tracking registration completion

C06.target_audience: People actively searching for event information
C06.objective: Help information-seeking visitors find details and complete registration

C07.target_audience: Members of student interest and community groups
C07.objective: Nurture community interest without over-contacting people who opt out

definitions.as_of: Inclusive IST date, implemented as < next local midnight. Naive XLSX timestamps are local IST.
definitions.first_touch: All person stages credited to the fixed People.first_campaign_id cohort.
definitions.registration_source: Identified = first touch, engagement = the interaction campaign, registration and current status = the registration campaign, attendance = verified visitors matched to any eligible registration in the campaign. Unregistered visitors go in Unattributed. Counts could overlap across campaigns if a person has registrations under different sources.
definitions.checkin_source: One campaign from earliest eligible verified admission sorted by occurred_at then event_id. Any-event distinct count also provided to surface potential overlap.
definitions.show_up: Intersection of registered or currently confirmed cohort and verified visitors divided by that cohort. Headline attendance includes walk-ins. No-show comparisons become mature by event close.
definitions.latest_status: Latest eligible full state per registration_id ordered by effective_at then history_id. Person totals within a status may overlap across statuses if a person has multiple registration IDs.
definitions.weekly: Monday to Sunday IST, partial first week. Period increments of cumulative distinct person cohorts. Confirmed delta is net of entries and exits.
definitions.spend: Whole INR net posted daily amounts, including negative vendor credits on their reporting date. Individual transaction-level gross debits and credits are unavailable.
definitions.null_rates: A zero denominator or missing coverage; spend and CPA for unattributed traffic are not allocable.

data_quality.owner_reference_note: No independent team dictionary sheet is supplied. Campaigns provide the available owner reference.
